topicSummary.text: Courteous, helpful service stands out, with staff handling requests well and keeping interactions warm across the front desk, housekeeping, and restaurant.
Central Bengaluru location makes it easy to get around, with Cubbon Park, Chinnaswamy, UB City mall, and other city spots close by.
Breakfast gets strong praise for taste and variety, with reviews mentioning a wide buffet spread, many fruits, sweets, juices, and good coffee.
Clean, tidy rooms and spotless bathrooms come up often, with several reviews describing the rooms as well maintained and hygienic.
Value for money comes through in several reviews, especially for the central location, clean rooms, facilities, and overall quality at the rate paid.
On-site dining earns praise for good food, with reviews highlighting the restaurant and in-room dining as enjoyable parts of the stay.
